sources.notes: 387-page republication of the CGI carrying article numbering and the amending law citations in-text (e.g. Loi n°2015-06 du 23 mars 2015 for Article 369, Loi n°2018-10 du 30 mars 2018 for Article 380). The official DGID portal (dgid.sn) was unreachable from this environment (TLS certificate error) at collection time; this is a text-verified secondary republication, not the primary government portal itself. Amendments after March 2019 may not be reflected.
